title: One Joint Too Many: The Null Space of a Seven Joint Arm, Moving the Elbow While the Hand Stays, and Steering Away From the Limits

artifact.note: redundancy: the part of a joint motion that the tool does not feel (the null space, as the motion less the damped solution for the tool velocity it would cause), the margin of a joint to its nearest limit as a share of its range, the gradient of the squared distance of the joints from the middle of their limits, a self motion run in which the joints move toward the middle of the limits while the tool is held (with and without a correction of its error), and the effect of clamping to the limits on iteration with seven joints
